## Very disappointing experience – misleading service, no support, no refund
I had a very bad experience with socleads.com and would strongly advise others to be careful.  
  
I paid around $1700 expecting high-quality, targeted leads as advertised. However, the results were extremely poor. Most of the data was irrelevant, outdated, or completely unusable for my needs. It did not match what was promised on their website.  
  
I reached out to their support team multiple times via email, but I never received a single response. There was no support, no explanation, and no attempt to resolve the issue.  
  
This lack of communication, combined with poor service quality, is extremely concerning. [...] We’re sorry to hear that Socleads didn’t meet your expectations. Our support team has already responded in detail, but we’re happy to clarify everything once more here:  
  
1. Social media platforms do not always provide accurate location data. For precise location targeting, we recommend using the built-in Google Maps scraper in Socleads.  
  
2. In your case, the scraper worked correctly and returned valid results. As per our policy, we do not offer refunds for leads that are considered "unsuitable" based on subjective criteria.  
  
3. Searching for keywords in bios is not legally offered by any compliant service, as it violates Meta’s terms of use and is not permitted under U.S. law. [...] Mar 21, 2025

Image 31: Rated 1 out of 5 stars

## Bad quality and poor customer support
I purchased Socleads and am very disappointed with the quality of results, but moreover terrible customer support. 1) location filter doesn't work for social media, if you select US - 70% of the list can easily be outside US 2) quality of the search differs from case to case sometimes up to 80% of the searches being completely irrelevant. I raised this problem to the support team but they refused to fix the problem or even reimburse the credits. 3) no option to search for keyword in bio, which worsense the quality of results 4) if you search the same keyword, 100% of the previous search result is included each time in the new result.
